description: Spec 010 FR-004 and FR-011: the declared tuning grid for the phase-3 trackers, chosen on the seed-208 validation split at σ = 1° and frozen in the decision record. Objective: median range error (non-converged rows count as infinite) at manoeuvre_index + 30 samples on turning scenarios (tuned-turn) and at zig_index + 30 on held-course scenarios (tuned-straight). IMM in two stages: stage 1 scores every combination on the first stage1_scenarios qualifying scenarios of each kind; stage 2 re-scores the stage2_top best of stage 1 on all of them. The EKF grid is small and scored on all of them.
